nodes.label: Post Tag Management
nodes.source_location: ## Add tag to post / Remove tag from post

nodes.label: Publish-Cadence Static Generation
nodes.rationale: Site pages, blog posts, series, and portfolio entries change at publish cadence, so they use static generation.

nodes.label: Multi-Source Streaming SSR
nodes.rationale: Aggregate pages stream their shell while independent slower sections resolve.

nodes.label: Request-Time Dynamic SSR
nodes.rationale: User-curated, ranked, mutable, or externally refreshed data is rendered dynamically at request time.

nodes.label: Leptos Islands Boundary
nodes.rationale: Hydrating only the Header and ThemeToggle preserves interactivity without hydrating read-only page bodies.

nodes.label: WASM Safety Boundary
nodes.rationale: Server-only dependencies remain behind the ssr feature so browser builds do not pull in server runtimes.

nodes.label: Configuration Precedence
nodes.rationale: Environment variables take priority over plinth.toml and compiled defaults to support secrets and deployment-specific overrides.

nodes.label: Opt-In Plausible Analytics
nodes.rationale: Both domain and script URL must be configured before analytics is injected, keeping analytics fully opt-in.

nodes.label: systemd LoadCredential Secret Loading
nodes.rationale: apiKeyFile is loaded through systemd credentials so deployment secrets can come from agenix or sops-nix files.

nodes.label: systemd Hardening
nodes.rationale: The module limits privileges, namespaces, address families, devices, mounts, and writable paths by default.

nodes.label: WASM Feature Gating
nodes.rationale: Server dependencies are gated with the ssr feature because the client compiles to WASM without Tokio or Axum.

nodes.label: Parameterized SQLx Queries
nodes.rationale: Parameterized queries avoid string-built SQL and keep nullable values and list ordering explicit.

nodes.label: Transactional Tag Writes
nodes.rationale: Junction tables and denormalized tag caches must be updated together in one transaction.

nodes.label: Nix Sandbox Constraints
nodes.rationale: Tests must avoid runtime downloads and use a fallible reqwest client builder because the Nix sandbox has no network or CA certificates.

nodes.label: Isolated PostgreSQL Test Databases
nodes.rationale: sqlx creates an isolated database per integration test and applies migrations before passing the test a PgPool.

nodes.label: Network-Free Tests
nodes.rationale: Nix sandbox tests cannot download fastembed models or make HTTP requests.

nodes.label: Activity API Authentication and Rate Limits
nodes.norm_label: activity api authentication and rate limits

nodes.label: Private Immich Image Proxy
nodes.rationale: Immich is not exposed publicly; Plinth authenticates with an API key and streams images to readers.

nodes.label: UUID Asset Validation
nodes.rationale: The image asset ID is validated as a UUID to prevent path traversal.

nodes.label: Typst Image Upload and URL Rewriting
nodes.norm_label: typst image upload and url rewriting
